text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while swamped with paperwork... I 
decided to take a break and stretch my 
body...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Would you like to bask in the sun 
with me?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, I found a wonderful spot. 
I just had to share it with you, Trainer!"
choice_data_list:
In that case, maybe I'll go for a change 
of pace.
Sorry, I've got a lot of work piling up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading to Rhein Kraft's recommended 
sunbathing spot together. Beneath the 
sunlight filtering through the trees, the 
warmth is just right...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Howaaaa... It's so warm~...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I can feel it slowly sinking 
in......

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Trainer-san, please have some 
of this too~. It's my special "cozy blend" 
tea.
choice_data_list: Are you sure I can have this?
Are you sure I can have this?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because happiness feels so much 
warmer when shared.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*Gulp, gulp*... Haaah~... It's warming me 
up from the inside out~...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... It feels like... I've 
become... the sun... zzz...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, there she is. Craft-cha—... Whoops.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
My, taking an afternoon nap, were we? 
Pardon my intrusion.
choice_data_list: Do you need something from Craft?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup~. We've really been in 
Craft-chan's debt~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She's shown me great spots for sunbathing 
and things like that~. I wanted to return 
the favor today, but—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Everyone together... so warm... 
mnya.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You just can't wake her up, can you~? Not 
with such a happy, squishy sleeping face.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"So, basically... Craft's Trainer, could 
you pass along a message?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
What?! Sky-san and the others are gonna 
show me the best sunbathing spots...?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh...! I wonder what kind of place it 
is! I can't wait for tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sharing happiness and being loved by 
everyone. Seeing this side of Rhein Kraft 
warmed my heart.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Is that so! Sorry for interrupting 
your work...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll invite you again sometime! Good 
luck with work, Trainer-san!
